title: gatedloop plan-tier verdict
description: What a plan-tier classifier prints on stdout, and what `gates plan classify --verdict` accepts from the built-in gatedloop.blast-radius lens (plan-preflight design D3). Typed answers, one per dimension of rules/plan-tier-dimensions.json, each with its confidence; `reason` is optional because a typed-answer classifier cannot produce one. The shim combines the answers, and a verdict may only raise the plan's tier. `bin/gates` validates it with a stdlib validator (`_plan_tier_errors`), and a contract test keeps the two in step.
